title: A Stunning Aftermath
description: With Fixer and Camie ducking for cover, Boba Fett beat one of the Kintan Striders Gang members with his Tusken cycler rifle, until the weapon exploded in his hands. Throwing the pieces to the side, Fett advanced to the next group, pulling out his gaffi stick. One by one the gang members fell to Fett's unyielding and brutally vicious attacks. The entire crew can't keep pace with Fett's assaults. To finish off his masterpiece of a room clearing, Boba grabbed one of the Nikto thugs, and threw him through an interior window, sending him smashing into the bar.
